title: What It Actually Looks Like to Know You're Right and Ask the Question Anyway
caption:
You can be right and still ask the question.

Not because you doubt yourself. Because Proverbs 12:15 says the fool is right in his own eyes, and the wise man listens anyway.

Say it once. Ask anyway. Let the answer move you, or don't bother asking. The real test isn't whether you're right, it's whether you'd rather be corrected by truth than be seen as right.
